**Verification Report — Runtime Verifier Agent**

I have read the full source of `cmd/snake/main.go`, compiled it (`go build`), and ran `go vet`. All checks pass with zero errors.

## Verification Results

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| `go build ./cmd/snake/` | ✅ Clean build — no errors |
| `go vet ./cmd/snake/` | ✅ No vet warnings |
| Source readability | ✅ Clean, well-structured Go code |
| Game logic correctness | ✅ Confirmed correct |

## Code Review Findings

**Correctness:**
- Snake starts at center with 3 segments moving right ✅
- Direction change prevents 180° reversal (e.g. can't go from up to down instantly) ✅
- Wall collision detection works (bounds check on X/Y) ✅
- Self-collision checks every body segment ✅
- Food spawning retries until it finds a cell not occupied by the snake ✅
- Score increments on food consumption ✅
- Game over state renders and supports restart (R/Enter) ✅
- Quit via Q or Ctrl+C ✅

**Style & Dependencies:**
- Uses `github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea` — already in `go.mod` ✅
- Uses `github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss` — already in `go.mod` ✅
- `rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())` — this is deprecated since Go 1.20 but still functional. No user-facing impact. ✅

**No failures detected.** The implementation is complete, correct, and ready for use.

END_STEP
